verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents an emergency-stop capability, a stop command, or a safety-interlock pattern. The nearest items are adjacent: SDK sessions managed 'for safety' with no stated stop-on-disconnect behavior, collision-checked motion planning, per-method user permissions, and logic modules a developer could use to build threshold reactions. None of these is a documented e-stop or interlock pattern.

support.subject: As a robotics engineer, I can implement emergency-stop and safety-interlock patterns the platform documents and supports
